label: PEN A STORY · ONE STORY

slides.text: Exam hall. My pen died. Three hours to go.
The girl at the next bench slid her spare pen across. Didn't say a word.
When the exam ended, I looked for her to return it. She was gone.
Fifteen years, that pen sat on my desk. Every interview. Every signature.
Today a patient at my clinic asked to borrow a pen for her form.
I handed her that pen. She looked at it and smiled. "Isn't this mine?"
Has a tiny kindness ever changed your life?
